key_derivation: Four independent exclusions, each read off a committed file. (1) test/test_helper.exs:28 sets `excludes = [:mix_phx_new]`; `git grep -n 'mix_phx_new' test/` returns exactly one tagged module, test/mix/tasks/phx.gen.auth_test.exs:6 -- run with `mix test --only mix_phx_new` (.github/workflows/ci.yml:127). (2) The root project compiles only lib/ (mix.exs:60) and its test path is `test`, so installer/ and integration_test/ -- each a separate Mix project with its own mix.exs and mix.lock -- are unreachable; run with working-directory installer (ci.yml:119-121) and integration_test (ci.yml:324-328).
